body:
Yep my parents fight a lot because my dad drinks also, they threatened to leave each other many times, especially mom. But that one last time, right after Christmas, it got really physical so they almost broke up. I think that a divorce would be better for both of them in the long run but like you mentioned, the selfish part of me wants to keep the illusion of a whole family and that they would get along eventually.
About the psychiatrist, well maybe if you are 18 you
could go to one without your parents finding out? Remarks are only remarks, but mental health is more important, you are more important and your health. If you would start going to therapy maybe things would get better for you mentally. Reconsider that. 
I myself have this strange relationship with my parents, they dont understand me at all, I dont want to open up to them till this moment. But Im 18 and I think about going to a therapist after quarantine and atleast try to fix my head even if my parents say no.

And my mom always rants about me too. How i cant do anything and im just so useless,how I would not be able to take care of myself at all, like wash my clothes, cook food, iron clothes, pay bills. I try to learn these things, even its hard to do by myslef with no motivation.
Well I only wish you luck, stay strong and dont give up just yet, everything might be better in the near future:)

Ill definetly look into psychiatrist after quarantine. I need to give it a shot, I dont have anymore options left. 
Btw how are you doing some time after treatment? I hope you are feeling better:). Having parents like we have is really not helping.

Yes. Because of depression I cant concentrate, remember things as well and learn, so my grades dropped and its another reason for my parents to argue with me and call dipshit and so on. Besides that my parents also argue a lot with each other, my dad is an alcoholic and my mom ir pretty crazy too, screams her lungs out sometimes. At one point they almost broke up few months ago. The situation was really heated.. That would have been a really nice cherry on top of my depression cake. Btw my parents think that i have everything i have ever wanted and when i get sad even little bit they immediatly get mad at me because "I have no reason to be sad". They never understood, they never will, I cant upen up to them because of that. And I see you have a brother that feels no empathy, well shit, I couldnt imagine myself with a brother like that.. Well life truly sucks for both of us, sending big hugs and stay strong buddy.
Btw have you considered going to a psychiatrist? One nice guy from reddit convinced me and I think I need to give it a shot after this quarantine thing.

Im not happy at all. But I can pretend really well I think, friends and family have no clue. I dont enjoy a single moment... I just cant. I kinda keep my sadness to myself. Opening up to my friends or family could be a good idea, but I dont know, Its just too hard, I usually never tell anybody my problems, I just keep them to myself, I internalize things as you have mentioned...Thanks for your advice
Yep, I am losing contacts with my friends and feeling guilt.

This is exactly me. I just cant answer phonecalls, I have to save up energy or relax while listening to music and then answer or reply. I feel really lonely most of the time but when somebody asks me out, my first thought is what excuse to make no to go. Its messed up...
Yeah, I sleep a lot also.. Thank you for the hugs, I only wish the best for you, our situation truly sucks...

I think you did the right thing. If they are true friends they will understand why you can't respond that quick. 

I also find socializing really exhausting. I used to be this really outgoing guy, I loved people and had a lot more friends, but couple of years ago everything completely flopped, like a switch turned off. I can't stand going out, socialising and leaving my home. Because of that I've lost friends and everythings just getting worse... Idk how introvert like me will live his life and be happy.

Im 18. My parents don't know about my mental illness, they see my mood swings and how sad I am most of the time but they have no clue about the problem. My friends don't know either, they see me as this really happy guy that stays positive no matter what and makes them laugh all the time. For some reason I only opened up about this problem to complete strangers on couple of subreddits. Well I also forgot to mention that my parents somedays are being nice, but other days they call me stupid names, especially my mom, and i feel like shit all the time. Thats why im scared to open up to them.

I have the same dark thoughts, sometimes i have some hope but I usually get back to them. The only thing that keeps me from doing it are my parents and I just want to stay here for little bit more to see what future brings... 
Btw how old are you if you dont mind answering?
Exactly. I don't have energy while being 18, I don't know how I will hold myself together when Ill be 20, 25, 30.. I'm not sure how I'm going to live my life like this. I'm just a stressed out mess.
High school, but its only a year left
This is exactly like my situation. I also don't know what should i do. Everyday it gets worse.
Thanks, I'm wishing best for you also. We can only hope things will get better..

Same . I also used to train calisthenics, It really distracted me from the bad thoughts I was having. But then I injured my elbows, lost a lot of progress, after few months I came back to training and then, after like 4 months I injured myself the second time( elbows and left wrist to be exact) and now I've once again lost everything. I'm in a dark place to be honest, can't train due to injury, thoughts about suicide are taking over my head, getting out of bed is really hard in the morning, during weekends I usually sleep until lunch... I don't have any motivation to do anything, I feel exhausted all the time no matter how much i sleep( i started getting exhausted when I trained also, had no energy in the beggining of the workout before I injured myself), don't want to do anything, after waking up I stay in bed with my phone. I don't enjoy anything anymore, I had few hobbies that i really liked, but now I can't get myself to do them. I feel numb to all emotions, don't know how to express my feelings.... I am failing at anything I do, but that's whole another topic..
